svg.text: Kafka acks e2 and e3 before e1. Then one status update, then kill -9.
Slot follows the latest ack (factlib main): the status update confirms e3
Slot follows the contiguous acked prefix: e1 is missing, so the slot stays
Green: in Kafka before the crash. Hatched: in flight. Red: behind the slot but not in Kafka.
After the restart, Postgres resends every transaction at or after the slot.
